description: This Java class defines configuration properties for JWT (JSON Web Token) signing and token settings, such as secret key, issuer, and expiration time, used in authentication processes.

classes.name: JwtProperties
classes.description: Holds JWT configuration properties such as secret key, issuer, and token expiration time.

methods.name: getSecret
methods.description: Retrieves the secret key used for signing JWTs.

methods.name: setSecret
methods.description: Sets the secret key used for signing JWTs.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Retrieves the issuer of the JWT tokens.

methods.name: setIssuer
methods.description: Sets the issuer of the JWT tokens.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMinutes
methods.description: Retrieves the token expiration time in minutes.

methods.name: setAccessTokenMinutes
methods.description: Sets the token expiration time in minutes.
